liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Thank You (Falettinme Be Mice Elf Agin)** (1 review): Track twenty-six combines the Sly and the Family Stone and Janet Jackson covers [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Dancing In The Dark**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **Holding On To Black Metal**: back after 22 archived shows (581 days) [9]
- **Magic Bullet**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 7 archived performances [9]
- **Miss You**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **New Years Countdown**: back after 82 archived shows (1826 days); rare: 3 archived performances [9]
- **Everyday People**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **Dancefloors**: back after 22 archived shows (581 days) [9]
- **What The World Needs Now**: back after 21 archived shows (491 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [9]

## The recordings

- **mmj2017-12-31.fm.flac16** (recommended): FM broadcast; 27 songs; 155 min [1]
- **mmj2017-12-31.mk41v.flac16**: source not stated; 26 songs; 160 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: This source offers superior vocal clarity, instrument separation, and dynamic range compared to other audio files [7]
- **mmj2017-12-31**: source not stated; 27 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **mmj2017-12-31.dpa4018a.flac16**: source not stated; 26 songs; 162 min [4]

## Around the show

- A confetti cannon positioned directly in front of the audience fired for forty-five seconds after midnight [4]
- Sunday performances feature a party and disco style, unlike Friday's psychedelic jams or Saturday's rock [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2017-12-31.fm.flac16**: source: HD FM > Sony XDR-F1HD > Tascam HD-P2 (16/44) [1]
- **mmj2017-12-31.mk41v.flac16**: taped by Chris King; source: Schoeps mk41v (din) > kcy > aki > M222 > NT222 > Sonosax SX-R4+ (24/96) [2]
- **mmj2017-12-31**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: AKG ck61 > Naiant Couplings/PFA > Naiant Tinybox > Sony M10 (24/48) [3]
- **mmj2017-12-31.dpa4018a.flac16**: taped by Scott Schneider; transferred by Scott Schneider; source: DPA 4018a(PAS@30cm/OTS@10')->SD788T(24/96) [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Status Serigraph: [2017 My Morning Jacket - Broomfield III Green Variant Concert Poster by Guy Burwell](https://www.jojosposters.com/products/2017-my-morning-jacket-broomfield-iii-green-variant-concert-poster-by-guy-burwell) [10]
- Poster by Status Serigraph: [2017 My Morning Jacket - Broomfield III Green Variant Concert Poster by Guy Burwell](https://www.jojosposters.com/products/2017-my-morning-jacket-broomfield-iii-green-variant-concert-poster-by-guy-burwell) [11]
